create.name: Wendy De Rosa
create.bio:
Working with sensitive and empathic people, Wendy De Rosa teaches, writes and practises as an intuitive energy healer. At the School of Intuitive Studies, which she founded, her year-long Energy Healing and Intuition Training shows students how to read and clear their own energy system through the chakras, build their intuition and work as intuitive healers themselves. She also has a podcast, The Wendy De Rosa Sessions, and runs The Sanctuary, a monthly membership offering live group healings and meditations.

Grounding and energetic boundaries are central to her teaching, as are the four intuitive pathways of clairvoyance, clairaudience, claircognizance and clairsentience, which she teaches through guided practice rather than through theory alone. Her books are Expanding Your Heart: Awakening Through Four Stages of a Spiritual Opening, Becoming an Empowered Empath and Energy Healing Through the Chakras. She has taught at Kripalu, Omega and Blue Spirit, and The Shift Network has hosted many of her live and self-paced courses for empaths.

books.title: Becoming an Empowered Empath: How to Clear Energy, Set Boundaries & Embody Your Intuition
books.author: Wendy De Rosa
books.description: A practical guide for empaths and highly sensitive people on clearing absorbed energy through the chakras and setting energetic boundaries. It includes exercises for grounding and for trusting intuitive perception. Foreword by Gabrielle Bernstein.

books.title: Expanding Your Heart: Awakening Through Four Stages of a Spiritual Opening
books.author: Wendy De Rosa
books.description: Describes four stages of a spiritual opening and how life's hard passages can become a way of opening the heart. Wendy De Rosa draws on her own experience and her healing work with clients.

books.title: Energy Healing Through the Chakras: A Guide to Self-Healing
books.author: Wendy De Rosa
books.description: A short, experiential introduction to the chakras and how energy moves through the body. Each chapter pairs explanation with simple practices for working with your own energy.

courses.title: Energy Healing & Intuition Training
courses.description: Wendy De Rosa's year-long training at the School of Intuitive Studies. Students learn to clear emotional and energetic patterns, ground in their own energy and develop their intuition, with a path to certification as an intuitive healer. Enrolment opens by cohort; there is a waitlist.

courses.title: The Sanctuary Membership
courses.description: A monthly membership with live group healings and meditations led by Wendy, monthly themes and an on-demand library of past healings, workshops and courses.

courses.title: Thrive at Work: How to Manage Your Energy For People Who Work with People
courses.description: A recorded course for people whose work involves caring for or leading others. It covers managing personal energy, keeping clear boundaries and working from intuition and clarity.

courses.title: Expand Your Powers of Intuition as a Sensitive or Empath
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced course on the four intuitive pathways and how to receive intuitive information without taking it on. It includes guided chakra healings and practices for energetic boundaries.

courses.title: Empowered Intuitive Living for Empaths
courses.description: A ten-module self-paced course for empaths. Guided practices clear and settle the chakras, set energetic boundaries and help you ground in your own truth.

courses.title: The Empath's Journey
courses.description: A twelve-module advanced training for sensitives and empaths. It deepens all four intuitive pathways through guided chakra healings in the upper and lower body, and includes her introductory intuition course.

courses.title: Advanced Energy Training for Empaths
courses.description: A sixteen-module recorded training on clearing emotional and karmic patterns held in the chakra system. It includes guided healings and an introduction to reading energy intuitively without absorbing it.

courses.title: The Four Foundations of Intuitive Healing
courses.description: A seven-module recorded audio training that works with energetic imprints in the lower chakras. It covers clearing emotional and energetic blocks, setting boundaries and opening to your own intuitive healing gifts.

courses.title: Next Level of Intuitive Healing
courses.description: A sixteen-session recorded training that moves from the lower to the upper chakras. It focuses on soul-level clearing, connection to inner guidance and what Wendy calls an upper-body awakening.

free_resources.title: How to Develop Your Intuition
free_resources.description: A free three-part video course on how intuition shows up, how energy and conditioning can block it, and how to use it in everyday decisions. It includes guided practices.
